data.title: Keturah Tower
data.about:
Experience residential living like no other at Keturah Tower by MAG Group in Dubai's Business Bay, a 46-story residential marvel. Following the success of Keturah Reserve and Keturah Resort, Keturah Tower Dubai emerges as a sought-after address. 

Positioned on Dubai Water Canal, The Keturah Tower Apartments are expected to number around 311, ranging from studios to 1 and 2 bedroom layouts. Ideal for both families and professionals, Keturah Tower in Business bay offers a contemporary lifestyle in the heart of Dubai.

Keturah Tower presents a unique opportunity for those seeking a blend of luxury and practicality. Embracing the 'Bio Living' concept first seen in Keturah Reserve, these residences integrate natural elements into urban living, enhancing well-being. For those interested in Keturah Residences or exploring the Dubai Downtown lifestyles, Keturah Tower is an excellent choice, especially for those familiar with the allure of the luxurious Keturah Brand.

characteristics_module.title: Reside in a residential gem at Keturah Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Double-volume interior spaces in homes for improved air flow and circulation.
  • Open-plan design eliminates corridors/hallways, enhancing movement.
  • Custom-designed, tailor-made furniture and fixtures for seamless integration and flow.
  • Keturah Apartments range from 600 to 2,200 square feet.
  • Incorporates a 'bio-living' theme with natural elements in design.
  • Modern architectural design with staggered, protruding floors for a terraced effect.
  • Terraces with vegetation, creating a vertical garden look.
  • Building façade made of clear glass and solid panels for natural light and privacy.
    Project managed by Mirage, with a three-year timeline: one year for design and contractor procurement, two years for construction and handover.

location_tile.title: Luxurious living in Keturah Tower at Business Bay
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Discover the allure of Keturah Tower prominently situated in Business Bay alongside the picturesque Dubai Water Canal. This area transcends its reputation as a mere business hub, featuring luxurious Apartments and Residences. Located a stone's throw from Downtown Dubai and is a cultural hotspot with events like music festivals and New Year's celebrations. 

Keturah Tower Dubai is not just a place to live, but a lifestyle choice, offering proximity to elite schools, healthcare, and financial services. Here, you can enjoy a sophisticated lifestyle with the added beauty of waterfront views.
